images.public_text:
Data Description
You are given a hotel booking dataset containing
information about multiple hotels and cities in
India. It includes four interconnected tables:
1. hotel_bookings - Contains booking-level data.
The customer_id refers to the customers table
and city_id refers to the cities table.
2. customers - Details of all customers, including
their home city (city_id links to the cities table).
3. hotels - Information about each hotel, including
its location (city_id links to the cities table).
4. cities - Contains details of each city along with
the state in which it is located.
5. hotel_bookings_flatten- day wise booking data
